const int MAXN = 266666;

long long power_mod(long long base, long long exp) {
    long long res = 1, cur = base;
    while (exp) {
        if (exp & 1) res = res * cur % mod;
        cur = cur * cur % mod;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d %d %d", &n, &k, &mod);
    if (n & 1) {
        printf("%lld\n", power_mod(k, n));
        return 0;
    }
    fact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) fact[i] = fact[i-1] * i % mod;
    invfact[n] = power_mod(fact[n], mod-2);
    for (int i = n-1; i >= 0; --i) invfact[i] = invfact[i+1] * (i+1) % mod;
    n >>= 1;
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
        int pc = __builtin_popcount(i);
        coef[pc][i] = invfact[i*2];
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 17; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < 17; ++j)
            for (int mask = 0; mask < (1<<17); ++mask)
                if ((mask >> j) & 1)
                    coef[i][mask] += coef[i][mask ^ (1<<j)];
    for (int i = 0; i < 17; ++i)
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1<<17); ++mask)
            coef[i][mask] %= mod;
    int target_pc = __builtin_popcount(n);
    for (int mask = 0; mask < (1<<17); ++mask) {
        memset(dp, 0, sizeof(dp));
        dp[0][0] = 1;
        for (int j = 1; j <= k; ++j) {
            for (int u = 0; u <= 17; ++u) {

                }
            }
        }
        result[mask] = dp[k][target_pc];
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 17; ++i)
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1<<17); ++mask)
            if ((mask >> i) & 1)
                result[mask] = (result[mask] - result[mask ^ (1<<i)]) % mod;
    long long answer = (power_mod(k, n*2) - result[n] % mod * fact[n*2] % mod + mod) % mod;
    printf("%lld\n", answer);
    return 0;
